items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: He had Milt Buckner and Wardell Gray, myself... Buckner used to write for the band and I'd write for the band.

ctx.x: What kind of a band did he have?
It was pretty good. He had Milt Buckner and Wardell Gray, myself, and a cat named Duck who played trumpet...
Would you say this was the best band you had played with up to that point?
